tldr: An open Ask Us Anything BOF with Quarkus core team members and extension contributors on the ecosystem, community involvement and the team's agentic AI work.
summary: Hosted by Dimitris Andreadis, the session brings together Quarkus core team members and extension contributors to discuss anything around the Quarkus ecosystem. The abstract cites 800+ extensions in the Quarkiverse, 1000+ contributors and the project's move to the Commonhaus Foundation.
Attendees are invited to bring questions and challenges, contribute ideas to shape the project's future, and hear about how to get involved, including the team's work on agentic AI.
keyPoints: Open Q&A with Quarkus core team members and extension contributors.
Quarkus has 800+ extensions in the Quarkiverse and 1000+ contributors.
Quarkus is now part of the Commonhaus Foundation.
Discussion includes the team's agentic AI work.
takeaways: Bring a concrete Quarkus question or feature idea to the team.
watchIf: You use or contribute to Quarkus and want to talk directly with the team.
